Absolute scam. My dog is on thyroid medication, and the lack of communication and consistency around her required bloodwork has become incredibly frustrating.

Multiple times, I’ve brought her in for expensive bloodwork and been told she wouldn’t need to come back for another year. Then, just a few weeks later, I’m told they won’t refill her thyroid medication unless I bring her in for bloodwork again. When I called to clarify, one receptionist told me to disregard the request because bloodwork wasn’t needed—only for someone else to call me the very next day and say that it was.

The last time I brought her in for bloodwork, they had to reschedule the appointment because I had already given her thyroid medication that day and apparently she needed to be medication-free beforehand. No one had given me those instructions when the appointment was scheduled, so I wasted my time because of their failure to communicate.

We’ve been coming here for years, and my dogs genuinely love this vet, which makes this especially disappointing. I understand that bloodwork is necessary to safely manage thyroid medication, but patients should be given clear and consistent information about when it’s required and why. Instead, I’ve received contradictory information from different staff members and repeated requests for costly testing shortly after being told it wouldn’t be needed.

At this point, it feels like they will squeeze you for every dime they can while taking zero accountability for their own communication failures. I’ve lost a lot of trust in a practice we used to really like.

(This situation and how it was initially handled was a bit of alot for me, but I dont want to harp on the negative; but thats why 4 stars) Ended up having to go back the next day for treatment and his hot spots had gotten MUCH worse. Ended up having to put him under and they shaved at least half his fur off to treat an allergic reaction and hot spots. At the end of this all, I feel the staff completely made things right! The vet came out and spoke with me; the vet tech I initially spoke with Kirby, was so nice and did give me some peace of mind, but Floyd has been nothing but the best. Even for the follow up visit, Floyd gave us peace of mind and explained everything to us. I really had a bad taste in my mouth, but truly I do feel like the staff cares about your pets well being.

I’ve been taking small dog here all of her life for yearly boosters and if she ever gets sick. My appointment was at 4pm, one of the front desk ladies asked around 4:30pm, who is that waiting. I announced my dog’s name and what time our appointment was originally for. She then went to ask the vet techs who had my dog.

Once they debated on who would see us, as soon as we got into the room, the vet tech tried upselling me while I told her the process we always take for my dog’s boosters. I declined. I then repeated that we don’t do the lepto because she had a bad reaction.

Everything gets handled, the vet comes in to introduce herself and we chat for a bit while she examines my dog and everything goes well. During the exam the vet tech finally introduces herself as well. After the exam the vet tech comes back into the room and says what my total is and asks for my form of payment. I guess they didn’t trust me to go to the front desk myself since so many other people walked right out without paying yesterday.

The vet tech comes back with one invoice and says we’re charging your card again because someone took off the lepto but it’s in the bundle which is discounted already so we have to charge you for it. There’s an alternative but we didn’t think of anything to give instead. So I was charged for a booster I didn’t receive since it’s already bundled and when I asked for said alternative she couldn’t tell me one. You would think with the upselling she attempted at the very beginning, there would have been an alternative spoken about when I said we don’t do the lepto booster.

Make sure you check your invoice so you aren’t being charged for things that you didn’t receive just because it’s a “discounted bundle” and I hope they allow you to walk to the front desk and pay your bill on your own. I’m very thankful my dog doesn’t get sick often, we will be going to another facility for her boosters from now on.

I am writing this review with a heavy heart. We recently had to put our 9 year old beagle to sleep because of aggressive cancer.  Let me start by saying this is our pets normal vet office.
We went to put our beagle to sleep on friday Oct 31st. We arrived already sad and upset but we didnt want our baby to suffer any longer.  When we got there we waited about an hour or so which was perfectly fine because that was precious time with Mr Tailz.
A while later the nurse came in and asked if we would like to be present for the euthanization which me my wife and son all wanted to be with our friend for his last moments. Keep in mind we've put our other beagle down here 1.5 years ago so we've been through this.
The nurse takes him back then returns with his catheter in his leg.  We spend a bit more time the the vet arrives.
